arguments.description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready status icon conveying successful completion: visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark navy #172336. Use the existing UI cool blue accent direction; #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact required palette. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. No fixed palette or binary-alpha restriction. Proposed representative sample before expanding the Working, Retry and Paused family; no approved style reference exists yet.

criteria.scope: Corrected proposal for the already-delivered representative Ready status sample (queue.ready; candidate ready.retained; assets/ready-confirmed.png sha256 fc5e43ae9db53c12cdb419794b36ef09a8ae8cf2be996954ae7390396a268ac5). This plan corrects citation bounds, authority wording and extent language found in the historical plan work/queue.ready-revision/candidate-plan.json (sha256 e7f85aa1f115b4f4c40cc5fc7c6e16a6313b4db36df4d133823241b9923750f6). It does not replace the contract used for delivery, does not re-verdict the delivered candidate and proposes no new generation. Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, readability, accent-relationship and sample-craft checks are rejection rules here. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused versus Ready), graphical renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus and the style-approval decision remain deferred obligations recorded in request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

comparisons.check: The cell exterior is transparent: pixels that are not part of the subject (the check mark plus any deliberate edge treatment, glow or backing shape) have alpha 0, and no opaque or translucent matte, box or canvas fill covers the cell as an unintended background. Partial alpha on subject pixels, including authored soft edges, is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
comparisons.basis: Owner brief requires transparent backgrounds (BRIEF.md line 3) and the current update keeps the transparent background (line 9). The brief does not restrict alpha to binary values and does not forbid deliberate subject components. The PIXL profile's transparency/subject-construction distinction separates an unintended opaque matte from an intentional backing or edge treatment; the historical wording 'no ... fringe fills the cell' was ambiguous about authored soft edges and is clarified here.
comparisons.scope: This Ready candidate file. The delivered sample happens to use binary alpha (227 alpha-0 pixels, 29 alpha-255 pixels; observation), which is not thereby required.

comparisons.check: Viewed alone at the declared display conditions, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms (one arm clearly shorter than the other) and reads as successful completion. It must not read as the existing idle Start triangle (assets/start.svg), and it must not read generically as activity, failure or pause. Comparison against actual Working, Retry and Paused art is a deferred family obligation, not part of this check.
comparisons.basis: BRIEF.md line 9 is the owner requirement for the check-mark motif, the asymmetrical arms and the successful-completion meaning. succeeded is the state reached by an ok result (src/queue.ts line 3) and maps to the Ready label and this asset (src/queue-view.ts line 6). Start is the only existing sibling asset (src/queue-view.ts line 3; assets/start.svg line 1). The owner leaves arm ratio, stroke width, end caps, backing shape, palette count and highlights open; none is imposed here. The historical citation of BRIEF.md line 3 ('working loop must communicate activity without looking like success') binds Working, not Ready, and is retained only as a deferred family obligation.

The historical wording 'blur' is clarified to accidental resampling blur so that authored selective anti-aliasing, which the brief permits, is not rejected.

source_evidence.locator: line 3: 'Create coherent pixel-art status assets'

excerpts.text: Create coherent pixel-art status assets for the queue UI. Preserve the existing vector Start control. Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels. Working uses four horizontal frames with a 100 ms frame duration. Ready and Retry are static images. Use transparent backgrounds, readable silhouettes and the existing UI's cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required. Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel. The working loop must communicate activity without looking like success. Error/retry must be distinguishable without color alone.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
requirements.reason: Decoded PNG is 16x16 with one static frame; no strip or extra canvas.

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
requirements.reason: 227 pixels are RGBA 0,0,0,0; 29 subject pixels are opaque blue. Transparent exterior and open corners have no matte or fringe; no binary-alpha rule imposed.

requirements.name: ready-meaning
requirements.check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion; it reads as completion rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
requirements.reason: Viewed native and 3x: a short descending left arm joins a distinctly longer ascending right arm into a clear check mark. It reads as successful completion rather than triangle, pause bars, loop or failure.

requirements.name: readability-1x-3x
requirements.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.
requirements.reason: Native 16x16 panel composite shows a recognizable light-blue check; 48x48 nearest composite preserves clear steps and essential asymmetrical arms against #172336.

requirements.name: cool-blue-accent
requirements.check: The dominant colour treatment visibly relates to the existing UI's cool blue accent as seen in assets/start.svg (#70b9ed). This is a visual relationship judgement, not an exact-hex or palette-count rule.
requirements.reason: Visible sky-blue treatment relates directly to the preserved Start SVG's cool-blue cue; measured color happens to equal #70b9ed, but exact equality was not a rejection rule.

requirements.name: sample-pixel-craft
requirements.check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: clean pixel clusters and edges, no noisy stray pixels, blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused.
requirements.reason: Viewed all native and enlarged views: compact connected stepped clusters form a crisp check without blur, isolated noise or downscaled illustration artifacts. A plausible sample for future family extension; family adoption and comparisons remain separate.
